summary: v0.1 verifier accepted a fully self-consistent forgery
root_cause: integrity checks (S1-S5) are all recomputable by an attacker; without a cryptographic seal, a rewritten package plus rewritten manifest/lifecycle is indistinguishable from genuine
detection: red-team fixture design (malicious.uibc) during Break-UIBC phase, not by the running verifier
fix: v0.2 HMAC-SHA256 seal + strict mode: forged packages FAIL at S6 when verified with the owner key
lesson: integrity checks without a secret cannot detect a fully consistent forgery; boundary: substitution with the owner's own key still requires out-of-band pinning
fixture_ref: fixtures/malicious.uibc (open: PASS surface, strict: FAIL S6)
